data.name: Sapna
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sapna', meaning 'dream' or 'vision'. In Hindu mythology, 'Sapna' is believed to be the goddess of dreams, who appears in our dreams to guide us and reveal our inner desires and aspirations. She is also associated with the night sky, the moon, and the stars.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the power of the subconscious mind to shape our reality through our dreams and visions.
data.numerology_meaning: Nurturer, Healer, Teacher, Problem Solver, Idealist, and Humanitarian.
